# DeepImage

AI Image Enhancer to Generate & Upscale

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/deepimage/.

## Actions

- **Delete Job**: Delete completed job result and remove images from the server.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve authenticated user's profile information including credits, username, email, API key, language preference, webhook settings, and…
- **Get Job Result** (read-only): Retrieve processing job result by hash.
- **Process Image Async**: Schedule an image enhancement job and wait for the result.
- **Process Image Synchronously**: Process an image synchronously with Deep Image AI.
